selectionMode.range: pick a start date and an end date

rules.selectionMode: Use range only for start/end pairs; value and defaultValue then hold two dates instead of one.
rules.label: Pass label for an accessible caption above the grid; Calendar has no visible label otherwise.
rules.icons: previousIcon, nextIcon and viewIcon override the built-in navigation glyphs without changing behavior.
rules.view: The heading itself steps day → month → year on click; there is no separate month/year <select>.
